excerpt_en: The life of one of the first fedayi leaders, and the fight at Geliguzan where it ended.
content_en: The life of one of the first fedayi leaders, and the fight at Geliguzan where it ended. Aghbyur Serob rose from a mountain village to become one of the most respected commanders of the early resistance, known for his restraint as much as his courage — a leader who protected villages before he fought battles, and whose death at Geliguzan in 1899 became one of the era's defining losses.
